mentions.name: ARC task heatmap viewer
mentions.description: This web viewer on the author's site visualizes ARC-AGI tasks using an entropy filtering + correlation perception algorithm, displaying heatmaps for random tasks that reveal information about the structure of each task and help build intuition for the algorithm.
mentions.source_excerpt: I made a viewer on my website to build intuition for my preferred perception algorithm which is entropy filtering + correlation. Pretty neat to check out the heatmaps for random tasks, there is a lot of information inherent in the heatmap about the structure of the task: https://synapsomorphy.com/arc/
